restaurant_name: Clinic Dr. Chaiwit (คลินิกแพทย์ขัยวิทย์)
text:
I’d like to say thank you to Dr.Chaiwit. He was the doctor of my choice when it came to giving birth in Phuket and I didn’t regret it once!

He truly cares about his patients, listens to you and your preferences. He’s very calm and professional. I felt safe and am happy with how everything went. It’s not always easy to find a good caring doctor, but Dr. Chaiwit is definitely one of them.

Thank you! ☺️

restaurant_name: Clinic Dr. Chaiwit (คลินิกแพทย์ขัยวิทย์)
text:
Medical certificate 100 baht, pregnancy test 100 baht.
I arrived at 5:30 PM to get a queue number, but the doctor didn't arrive until almost 7 PM. The staff were quite irritable, but the doctor was kind. The price was inexpensive. The restrooms were clean and spacious. There were plenty of seats while waiting in line.

restaurant_name: Clinic Dr. Chaiwit (คลินิกแพทย์ขัยวิทย์)
text: The queueing process was terrible, absolutely awful. We arrived and asked politely, but they answered dismissively and emotionally, shoving the paper and pen for us to sign in a very rude way, pushing it so hard the pen fell. I don't know what was wrong with them; they lacked maturity completely. I wouldn't recommend this place at all. We haven't even seen a doctor yet, and after experiencing this, we're giving up. We couldn't stand standing there asking questions; their responses were so careless. Find somewhere else where it's less awkward and more comfortable.

restaurant_name: Clinic Dr. Chaiwit (คลินิกแพทย์ขัยวิทย์)
text: 3 stars for the doctor, but everything else is a fail. The nurses here are not suitable for welcoming patients, especially new parents who need to be mentally prepared and practice mindfulness before going here. The older nurses have a lot of forceful movements.
